decision_contract: This is a bounded structural falsification test, not calibration, confirmation or a policy scenario.
No beta, contact, ART or PrEP control changes in this audit.
Every non-baseline profile must be exactly neutral at all quarterly evaluation times through 2019.75.
The disruption must be followed by a compensating recovery and return to the calibrated multiplier by 2024.
The profile is rejected if any paired pre-2020 output changes, if 2024 MSM diagnosis absolute error does not improve, or if 2022 MSM AIDS absolute error worsens.
No profile may be promoted into the calibration or HTA baseline from this audit.
